lines: By those two initiated who, their life-long behavior to be spoken, of putrakas and the rest, for accomplishment of identity.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tayobhayyā dīkṣitā ye teṣāmājīvavartanam vaktavyaṃ putrakādīnāṃ tanmayatvaprasiddhaye
